VolunteersController.php

```
public function registerIndividual() {
        $this->layout = 'register';

        // Get the volunteer id
        $id = $this->Cookie->read('VolunteerRegistration', 'volunteer_id');

        if(!$id){
            $volunteer = $this->Volunteers->newEntity($this->request->data);
            if ($this->request->is('post')) {
                $myVolunteer = $this->Volunteers->save($volunteer, ['validate' => 'ContactInformation']);
                if ($myVolunteer) {
                    // Update the cookie with the new volunteer id
                    $this->Cookie->write('VolunteerRegistration',
                        ['volunteer_id' => $myVolunteer->id,
                        'nextView' => 'registerEmail'
                        ]
                    );
                    $this->Flash->success('Your progress has been saved.');
                    return $this->redirect(['action' => 'registerEmail']);
                } else {
                    $this->Flash->error('Your progress could not be saved. Please check the form for errors and try again.');
                }
            }
        }
    }
```
